board: Joy-IT SensorKit KY-036 metal touch sensor module (black 4-pin: AO, G, +, DO; identical generic 37-in-1 kit KY-036)
reason: Modelled as a digital-sensor: DO (LM393 output with board pull-up) goes HIGH while the metal tip is touched, per Joy-IT documentation; the driver samples DO over 40 ms to ride over mains-hum flicker. Part check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
